Image.Title: Carousel image
Image.Hint: Custom image for {name} in the combat carousel. Cut-out full-body art (PNG or WebP with a transparent background) looks best.

TimerEnabled.Name: Enable turn timer
TimerEnabled.Hint: Shows a countdown below the active character. Can also be toggled on the carousel via the small hourglass at the bottom right (GM only).

TimerSeconds.Name: Turn timer: seconds per turn
TimerSeconds.Hint: How long a turn may take.

TimerScope.Name: Turn timer applies to
TimerScope.Hint: Whether the timer runs only for player characters or for NPCs too.

TimerExpire.Name: When the turn timer runs out
TimerExpire.Hint: Only show it, or end the turn automatically.

AnnounceTurn.Name: Large turn announcement
AnnounceTurn.Hint: On every turn change, everyone briefly sees the text and the image of the character whose turn it is.

AnnounceText.Name: Turn announcement text
AnnounceText.Hint: {name} is replaced with the name, e.g. "{name}'s Turn". If the name is hidden from players, ??? is shown.

AllowPlayerMove.Name: Players may move the carousel and announcements
AllowPlayerMove.Hint: If enabled, each player can arrange the carousel and the large announcements (including text relative to the image) for themselves. The arrangement is stored on their user account and applies to every character. Otherwise everyone uses the GM's arrangement.

MaxSlots.Name: Visible characters
MaxSlots.Hint: Maximum number of characters shown at once. With more combatants the carousel scrolls along.

PrevCount.Name: Already acted (left)
PrevCount.Hint: How many characters stay to the left of the active character.

ImageSource.Name: Image source
ImageSource.Hint: Which image is shown when no custom carousel image is set (right-click a figure in the carousel).

Show.Name: Show combat carousel
Show.Hint: Show or hide the carousel for everyone.

Scale.Name: Carousel size (%)
Scale.Hint: How large the carousel is drawn for everyone.

NextBanner.Name: "You're up next" notice
NextBanner.Hint: The player whose character is next in line gets a large notice.

Sound.Name: Notification sound
Sound.Hint: Short sound with the "You're up next" notice.

AnnounceEditor.Name: Set up large announcements
AnnounceEditor.Label: Open preview
AnnounceEditor.Hint: Shows the large turn announcement as a preview to move and adjust. Players can only open it if moving is allowed.

AnnounceTextScale.Name: Large announcements: text size (%)
AnnounceTextScale.Hint: Applies to everyone. Can also be set in the preview (Set up large announcements) with the slider or the mouse wheel over the text.

AnnounceImageScale.Name: Large announcements: image size (%)
AnnounceImageScale.Hint: Applies to everyone. Can also be set in the preview with the slider or the mouse wheel over the image.

Editor.Title: Set up large announcement
Editor.Hint: Drag the image to move the whole announcement · drag the text (blue outline) to move only the text · mouse wheel over text or image changes its size (applies to everyone)
Editor.HintPlayer: Drag the image to move the whole announcement · drag the text (blue outline) to move only the text. Your arrangement applies only to you, for every character.
Editor.NotAllowed: The GM has not allowed moving the large announcements.
Editor.ResetPlayersHint: Deletes every player's own arrangement (carousel and large announcements). Afterwards everyone uses your arrangement again.
